contentComplete.description: Records when a learner completes a course section or assessment, capturing course category, language, learner authentication state and role.

page.description: Captures page context including primary category, subcategory, language, page identifier and name for navigation tracking.

user.description: Contains learner profile attributes including authentication state, learner role, subscription tier, account details, access entitlements and traffic type.

video_progress.description: Records video playback progression events capturing subscription tier, access entitlements, authentication state, account ID and learner identification.

select_content.description: Fires when a learner selects or navigates to a course, lesson or learning content module to begin or resume study.

user_engagement.description: Records learner engagement activity with educational content including course, lesson, module and activity identifiers.
